div.head: Whiston’s chapter headings (compiled index)
div.note: These headings are transcribed from the 1856 Auburn and Rochester printing of William Whiston’s translation. Their arrangement as an index is editorial; this is not a reproduction of an original printed table of contents.
div.head: BOOK VI.
div.p: CONTAINING THE INTERVAL OF THIRTY-TWO YEARS.
FROM THE DEATH OF ELI TO THE DEATH OF SAUL.

list.label: I
list.item: THE DESTRUCTION THAT CAME UPON THE PHILISTINES, AND UPON THEIR LAND, BY THE WRATH OF GOD, ON ACCOUNT OF THEIR HAVING CARRIED THE ARK AWAY CAPTIVE; AND AFTER WHAT MANNER THEY SENT IT BACK TO THE HEBREWS.
list.label: II
list.item: THE EXPEDITION OF THE PHILISTINES AGAINST THE HEBREWS, AND THE HEBREWS' VICTORY UNDER THE CONDUCT OF SAMUEL THE PROPHET, WHO WAS THEIR GENERAL.
list.label: III
list.item: HOW SAMUEL, WHEN HE WAS SO INFIRM WITH OLD AGE THAT HE COULD NOT TAKE CARE OF THE PUBLIC AFFAIRS, INTRUSTED THEM TO HIS SONS; AND HOW, UPON THE EVIL ADMINISTRATION OF THE GOVERNMENT BY THEM, THE MULTITUDE WERE SO ANGRY, THAT THEY REQUIRED TO HAVE A KING TO GOVERN THEM, ALTHOUGH SAMUEL WAS MUCH DISPLEASED THEREAT.
list.label: IV
list.item: THE APPOINTMENT OF A KING OVER THE ISRAELITES, WHOSE NAME WAS SAUL; AND THIS BY THE COMMAND OF GOD.
list.label: V
list.item: SAUL'S EXPEDITION AGAINST THE NATION OF THE AMORITES, AND VICTORY OVER THEM, AND THE SPOILS HE TOOK FROM THEM.
list.label: VI
list.item: HOW THE PHILISTINES MADE ANOTHER EXPEDITION AGAINST THE HEBREWS, AND WERE BEATEN.
list.label: VII
list.item: SAUL'S WAR WITH THE AMALEKITES, AND CONQUEST OF THEM.
list.label: VIII
list.item: HOW, UPON SAUL'S TRANSGRESSION OF THE PROPHET'S COMMANDS, SAMUEL ORDAINED ANOTHER PERSON TO BE KING PRIVATELY, WHOSE NAME WAS DAVID, AS GOD COMMANDED HIM.
list.label: IX
list.item: HOW THE PHILISTINES MADE ANOTHER EXPEDITION AGAINST THE HEBREWS, UNDER THE REIGN OF SAUL; AND HOW THEY WERE OVERCOME BY DAVID'S SLAYING GOLIATH IN SINGLE COMBAT.
list.label: X
list.item: SAUL ENVIES DAVID FOR HIS GLORIOUS SUCCESS, AND TAKES AN OCCASION OF ENTRAPPING HIM, FROM THE PROMISE HE MADE HIM OF GIVING HIM HIS DAUGHTER IN MARRIAGE; BUT THIS UPON CONDITION OF HIS BRINGING HIM SIX HUNDRED HEADS OF THE PHILISTINES.
list.label: XI
list.item: HOW DAVID, UPON SAUL'S LAYING SNARES FOR HIM, DID YET ESCAPE THE DANGERS HE WAS IN, BY THE AFFECTION AND CARE OF JONATHAN, AND THE CONTRIVANCES OF HIS WIFE MICHAL; AND HOW HE CAME TO SAMUEL THE PROPHET.
list.label: XII
list.item: HOW DAVID FLED TO AHIMELECH, AND AFTERWARDS TO THE KINGS OF THE PHILISTINES, AND OF THE MOABITES; AND HOW SAUL SLEW AHIMELECH AND HIS FAMILY.
list.label: XIII
list.item: HOW DAVID, WHEN HE HAD TWICE THE OPPORTUNITY OF KILLING SAUL, DID NOT KILL HIM. ALSO, CONCERNING THE DEATH OF SAMUEL AND NABAL.
list.label: XIV
list.item: HOW SAUL, UPON GOD'S NOT ANSWERING HIM CONCERNING THE FIGHT WITH THE PHILISTINES, DESIRED A NECROMANTIC WOMAN TO RAISE UP THE SOUL OF SAMUEL TO HIM; AND HOW HE DIED, WITH HIS SONS, UPON THE OVERTHROW OF THE HEBREWS IN BATTLE.
